reason: The 2026-06-17 L=1000 H2 rerun (commit 00089f3) REJECTED on the Markov-1 null in all three dimensions (H0 T=14.85 p=0.0; H1 T=7.35 p=0.0; H2 T=5.16 p=0.0), contradicting the 2026-05-02 baseline (H2 p=0.690 ns). Manager root-cause review found the rejection is NOT a trustworthy H2 void signal but a threshold-comparability artifact: compute_rips_ph applies a per-cloud adaptive 75th-percentile threshold, so the observed cloud (auto-thresh 22.26) and the 50 Markov-1 null clouds (auto-thresh ~15.5) are placed on DIFFERENT filtration scales. Global-Markov-1 surrogates are genuinely less dispersed than the heterogeneous real data (all draws share one transition matrix), so their n-gram embeddings cluster more tightly -> smaller scale AND small null-null W2 (~2.2). The W2 statistic on per-cloud-thresholded diagrams therefore confounds overall dispersion/scale with void topology. The signature is the monotone all-dimension rejection (T-ratio H0 14.85 > H1 7.35 > H2 5.16): a global scale offset propagating through every homological degree, strongest where the diagram carries most mass (H0), not a dimension-specific 2-void discovery. The apparent flip vs 2026-05-02 is further confounded by the 2026-05-28 embedding re-freeze (H2 diagram coordinates ~60-80 then vs ~9-18 now, ~4x), so that baseline is not a valid anchor. Loadings are correctly frozen and shared across observed and null paths, and per-null seeds vary correctly (null auto-thresholds span 15.1-16.1) -- this is a method-design confound, not an implementation bug.

fix.name: pinned common threshold (matched-scale H2 Check)
fix.rule: Compute PH for the observed cloud AND every Markov-1 null cloud at a single common threshold tau = enclosing radius of the observed landmark sample (tau = pdist(obs_landmarks).max()), so both diagrams are built on the same filtration scale and W2 reflects topology at matched scale rather than mismatched filtration ranges.
fix.precedent: Identical to trajectory_tda/scripts/stage1/_battery_core.py probe_pinned_thresh (lines ~575-589), the robustness probe that confirmed the P01-A H1 length-matched W2 rejection survives matched-thresh (results/trajectory_tda_bhps/stage1/bhps_length_matched_truncate_frozen_probe-pinned-thresh_2026-05-31.json). The H2 Check simply never received this treatment; the 2026-05-28 re-freeze's new scale regime exposed the confound.
fix.no_dedup_asymmetry: The H2 path uses dedup=False, so observed and null landmark counts are already equal (1000 each). The confound is threshold-only; forced_n_dedup / probe_symmetric_dedup is NOT required.
fix.addresses_issue: Resolves deferred ISSUE M3 (75th-percentile threshold sensitivity) for the H2 Check: the matched-scale pin removes the per-cloud auto-thresh divergence M3 flagged.

feasibility: The enclosing-radius pin drives both clouds toward full edge density, so the H2 tetrahedron burden (~C(L,4) at density->1) exceeds the 2e10 pre-flight budget for L beyond a few hundred; a comparability-correct pinned H2 is only feasible at small L. The matched-scale H2 Check therefore runs at the LARGEST L (<=1000) for which the observed enclosing-radius filtration keeps the H2 tetra burden <= 2e10 (deterministic, maxmin seed=42). This is a real limitation: the L=1000 auto-thresh run was only feasible BECAUSE the confounded per-cloud threshold held the nulls at ~75% density.

protocol.phase_a_small_L_diagnostic: At L in {200, 300} (optionally 150), run the H2 Check (observed + B=50 Markov-1 nulls, seed=42) under BOTH (1) production per-cloud auto-thresh and (2) pinned common threshold tau=enclosing-radius, on the identical landmark samples. Report H0/H1/H2 mean W(obs,null), mean W(null,null), T-ratio, and p under each. Decisive read: if the H2 T-ratio collapses toward ~1 (fail to reject) under the pinned threshold while persisting under auto-thresh, the rejection is confirmed as the threshold-scale artifact.
protocol.phase_b_decision_run: GATED on Phase A and on Manager review. Run the pinned-threshold H2 Check at the largest feasible L (per the feasibility rule above) as the comparability-valid decision run; pair it with an auto-thresh run at the same L to document the confound. The decision rule is applied to the PINNED-threshold H2 p-value.
protocol.gating: Phase A reports to the Manager bus before Phase B. If Phase A's pinned H2 still strongly rejects at small L, STOP and escalate before Phase B -- a genuine H2 signal candidate requires Manager review, not auto-promotion.

A surviving H2 rejection under matched scale would be a genuine signal candidate -> escalate before any manuscript claim. The 2026-06-17 auto-thresh rejection is treated as confounded and is NOT promoted.
